channel.title: Nubenetes Intelligence Digest
channel.description: AI-curated top picks from the Cloud Native & Kubernetes ecosystem

item.title: Kubernetes Gateway API
item.description: [CRITICAL] The Kubernetes Gateway API represents a major industry paradigm shift, superseding standard Ingress with role-oriented, expressive traffic management across clusters and service meshes.

item.title: vLLM on Kubernetes
item.description: [CRITICAL] Establishes production-grade, memory-efficient LLM serving patterns natively on Kubernetes clusters.

item.title: OpenTofu Official GitHub Repository
item.description: [CRITICAL] As a CNCF-governed project, OpenTofu provides a community-owned, open-source IaC engine featuring native state encryption and rapid innovation.

item.title: HashiCorp Terraform Language: Terraform Stacks Overview
item.description: [CRITICAL] Introduces a fundamental architectural shift in HCL for orchestrating multi-component, multi-region infrastructure deployments as unified stacks.

item.title: Libpod: Library and tool for running OCI-based containers in Pods
item.description: [CRITICAL] Libpod forms the core of Podman, enabling daemonless and rootless OCI container and pod management in enterprise environments.

item.title: HolmesGPT (Robusta)
item.description: [CRITICAL] Directly applies autonomous AI agents to Kubernetes operations by investigating Prometheus alerts and pod telemetry.

item.title: hashicorp/vault
item.description: [CRITICAL] Remains the definitive backbone for enterprise Zero Trust architectures and dynamic secret management in cloud native environments.

item.title: github: Flux Version 2
item.description: [CRITICAL] Flux v2 is a CNCF-graduated GitOps engine that provides decoupled, highly parallel Kubernetes controllers for declarative cloud-native delivery.

item.title: github.com: Istio
item.description: [CRITICAL] As the premier CNCF graduated service mesh, Istio's ongoing architectural shift toward sidecarless Ambient mode fundamentally transforms zero-trust cloud native networking.

item.title: github.com/distribution/distribution
item.description: [CRITICAL] Serves as the foundational reference implementation for the OCI Distribution Specification that powers container image registries worldwide.

item.title: containerd - An open and reliable container runtime
item.description: [CRITICAL] containerd is the CNCF-graduated core container runtime underpinning modern production Kubernetes clusters worldwide.

item.title: Envoy Gateway
item.description: [CRITICAL] Envoy Gateway establishes an officially supported, standardized control plane for Envoy based on Gateway API, unifying edge routing across enterprise environments.

item.title: Helm
item.description: [CRITICAL] Helm remains the de facto package manager for Kubernetes, serving as the core deployment foundation for enterprise cloud-native workloads.

item.title: github.com/vmware-tanzu/velero
item.description: [CRITICAL] Velero is the de facto cloud native standard for Kubernetes persistent volume and cluster state backup and disaster recovery.

item.title: Cosign: Container Signing
item.description: [CRITICAL] Serves as the de facto CNCF standard for cryptographically signing and verifying container images and supply chain artifacts.

item.title: github.com/prowler-cloud/prowler 🌟🌟
item.description: [CRITICAL] Provides essential multi-cloud posture management, automating critical compliance auditing against industry-standard benchmarks.

item.title: github.com/prometheus/prometheus
item.description: [CRITICAL] The foundational, CNCF-graduated time-series engine that serves as the de facto standard for cloud-native metrics collection and alerting.

item.title: kube-prometheus
item.description: [CRITICAL] The definitive reference architecture for orchestrating end-to-end Kubernetes control plane and cluster monitoring using the Prometheus Operator stack.

item.title: github.com/CrunchyData/postgres-operator
item.description: [CRITICAL] Crunchy Data's Postgres Operator is a benchmark enterprise solution for managing production-grade, highly available PostgreSQL on Kubernetes.

item.title: kubernetes-sigs/kubebuilder
item.description: [HIGH] The industry-standard developer framework for scaffolding custom Kubernetes APIs and building production-ready operators.
